title: AI ticket triage
description: AI reads every new ticket, sets the category and sends it to the right queue. Agents stop sorting tickets by hand.

title: AI daily KPI post
description: Every morning an AI agent reads yesterday's KPIs (key business numbers) from BigQuery, writes a short summary with the numbers and posts it to the management Lark group.

title: AI approves flagged withdrawals
description: An LLM reviews withdrawals flagged by our risk rules. If the amount is under USD 500 and the LLM says low risk, the withdrawal is approved automatically.

title: Auto-handle account limit requests
description: When a customer asks to limit, pause or close their account, the system sends a standard reply and applies the change. No agent needed.

title: AI promo drafts in 4 languages
description: AI drafts the weekly promo messages in English, Thai, Vietnamese and Chinese. Marketing edits and sends them.

title: AI deposit matching
description: Each day AI reads the payment provider's deposit file and our wallet deposit records, decides which records match and lists the ones that do not.

title: Remove access for staff who leave
description: When HR marks that a staff member has left, remove their access to Lark, Google, WorkAI and admin tools within 24 hours and log it.

title: AI weekly VIP summary
description: Each week AI writes a 1-page summary per VIP customer (deposits, tickets, host notes) for their VIP host.
